description: Spillage, an unconventional map of badwater spills over stepped valleys and highlands: Deep Frontier puts two Deep Ore Veins on the terraces north and north-east of the start, two finite Deep Ore Sources (4,000 DeepOre) on the south ridge and the east highland, stone outcrops beside their pits next to the start, the launch pad on the south-east plateau, and no reactor site (no reactor-sized flat lies near water).

unmet.reason: The reactor needs a flat, dry 20x15 footprint within 15 cells of clean water. A scan of every terrain level finds exactly one 20x15 (rotated 15x20) flat dry footprint on the whole map, on the south-east plateau at level 9 (x 148-162, y 6-25), and it is 26 cells from the nearest clean water; no other level has a flat dry rectangle of 20x15 (the largest per level are 15x20 at level 9, 38x12 at level 16, 28x10 at level 5 and 10x29 at level 7).
